items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-27
items.q: I was transferred from Birold school to Joseph A. Craig

ctx.x: Oh, I went to school. I attended Catholic school when I was at Bar at St. Francis is on Bill and Maroney. And of course I used to go to Maroney school. It was a block around there just to be with the kids and the teachers seemed to like me and I could go into rooms. and then after I left Catholic school I went to Jones school which is on Annette and Galvest but there was also a part of the school we used to call it Bucket of Blood. It was an old long house with a bunch of rooms in it. And I don't know why they…
